GSE133998_capstone

# Read the raw RNA-seq count matrix for GSE133998

data <- read.table(
  "data/GSE133998_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv.gz",
  
# The first row of the file contains column names
# 第一行是列名，例如 GeneID 和各个 GSM sample ID
  header = TRUE,

# The file is tab-separated (TSV)
# 文件中的不同列由 Tab（制表符）分隔 
  sep = "\t",

# Keep the original sample names exactly as they appear in the file
# 保留原始列名，避免 R 自动修改 GSM sample names
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Check the dimensions of the dataset
dim(data)
## [1] 39376    19
# Display all column names
colnames(data)
##  [1] "GeneID"     "GSM3932569" "GSM3932570" "GSM3932571" "GSM3932572"
##  [6] "GSM3932573" "GSM3932574" "GSM4494689" "GSM4494690" "GSM4494691"
## [11] "GSM4494692" "GSM4494693" "GSM4494694" "GSM4494695" "GSM4494696"
## [16] "GSM4494697" "GSM4494698" "GSM4494699" "GSM4494700"
# Display the first 6 rows and first 5 columns
head(data[, 1:5])

## 2    653635        238        171        116        180
## 3 102466751         13          5          1          9

# Create a vector containing the 12 tissue sample IDs
# 建立一个向量，保存我们需要分析的12个组织样本
# 这些样本包括6个adjacent normal tissue 和6个cancer tissue

tissue_ids <- c(
  "GSM4494689",
  "GSM4494690",
  "GSM4494691",
  "GSM4494692",
  "GSM4494693",
  "GSM4494694",
  "GSM4494695",
  "GSM4494696",
  "GSM4494697",
  "GSM4494698",
  "GSM4494699",
  "GSM4494700"
)


# Select the GeneID column and the 12 tissue samples
# 从完整 raw count 数据中，只保留 GeneID 和这12个 tissue samples
counts <- data[, c("GeneID", tissue_ids)]


# Check the dimensions of the new count dataset
dim(counts)
## [1] 39376    13
# Check the column names
colnames(counts)
##  [1] "GeneID"     "GSM4494689" "GSM4494690" "GSM4494691" "GSM4494692"
##  [6] "GSM4494693" "GSM4494694" "GSM4494695" "GSM4494696" "GSM4494697"
## [11] "GSM4494698" "GSM4494699" "GSM4494700"
# Create sample metadata
# 建立样本信息表metadata
metadata <- data.frame(
  
  # Sample ID
  # 样本编号，与 count matrix 的列名对应
  sample = tissue_ids,
  
  # Biological condition
  # 标记每个样本属于Normal还是 Cancer
  condition = c(
    "Normal", "Cancer",
    "Normal", "Cancer",
    "Normal", "Cancer",
    "Normal", "Cancer",
    "Normal", "Cancer",
    "Normal", "Cancer"
  ),
  
  # Patient ID
  # 标记每一对 Normal 和 Cancer 来自同一个 patient
  patient = c(
    "H36", "H36",
    "H37", "H37",
    "H38", "H38",
    "H39", "H39",
    "H40", "H40",
    "H42", "H42"
  )
)


# Display the metadata
metadata
##        sample condition patient
## 1  GSM4494689    Normal     H36
## 2  GSM4494690    Cancer     H36
## 3  GSM4494691    Normal     H37
## 4  GSM4494692    Cancer     H37

## 12 GSM4494700    Cancer     H42

table(metadata$condition)
## 
## Cancer Normal 
##      6      6
# Count the number of samples for each patient
# 每个 patient 理论上应该有两个样本：
# 一个 Normal + 一个 Cancer
table(metadata$patient)
## 
## H36 H37 H38 H39 H40 H42 
##   2   2   2   2   2   2
# Check whether GeneID values are unique
# 检查 GeneID 是否存在重复
# DESeq2 中每一行最好对应唯一的 gene
anyDuplicated(counts$GeneID)
## [1] 0
# Move GeneID from a normal column to row names
# 把 GeneID 设置为每一行的名称
rownames(counts) <- counts$GeneID


# Remove the original GeneID column
# GeneID 已经成为 row names，因此删除原来的 GeneID column
counts$GeneID <- NULL


# Check the dimensions again
dim(counts)
## [1] 39376    12

head(counts[, 1:4])

# Check whether all expression values are integers
# 检查所有表达值是否都是整数
# DESeq2要求输入原始 count data，而不是 FPKM/TPM
all(
  sapply(
    counts,
    function(x) all(x == round(x))
  )
)
## [1] TRUE
# Check whether there are any negative values
any(counts < 0)
## [1] FALSE
# Look at the overall distribution of count values
# 查看所有 count 值的大致分布
summary(as.vector(as.matrix(counts)))
##     Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max. 
##      0.0      1.0     25.0    671.9    401.0 955908.0
# Use sample IDs as row names of metadata
# 把sample ID设置成metadata的行名
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample


# Reorder metadata rows to match the order of count matrix columns
# 按照counts的column顺序重新排列 metadata
metadata <- metadata[colnames(counts), ]


# Check whether count columns and metadata rows are perfectly matched
all(
  colnames(counts) == rownames(metadata)
)
## [1] TRUE
# Convert condition into a factor
# condition 是分类变量，而不是普通文字
metadata$condition <- factor(
  metadata$condition,
  levels = c("Normal", "Cancer")
)


# Convert patient into a factor
# patient 也是分类变量
metadata$patient <- factor(
  metadata$patient
)


# Check the structure of metadata
str(metadata)

# Create a DESeq2 dataset object
# 将 raw counts 和 metadata 组合成 DESeq2 可以分析的对象
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  
  # Raw integer count matrix
  # RNA-seq 原始整数 count 数据
  countData = counts,
  
  # Sample metadata
  # 每个sample的 condition 和 patient 信息
  colData = metadata,
  
  # Statistical design
  # patient：控制不同患者之间的个体差异
  # condition：检测 Cancer vs Normal 的差异
  design = ~ patient + condition
)


# Display the DESeq2 object
# 查看 dds 是否成功创建
dds
## class: DESeqDataSet 
## dim: 39376 12 
## metadata(1): version
## assays(1): counts
## rownames(39376): 100287102 653635 ... 4576 4571
## rowData names(0):
## colnames(12): GSM4494689 GSM4494690 ... GSM4494699 GSM4494700
## colData names(3): sample condition patient
# Identify genes with sufficient expression
# 一个 gene 至少需要在 3 个 samples 中 count >= 10 才保留
keep <- rowSums(
  counts(dds) >= 10
) >= 3


# Count how many genes will be retained
# 查看过滤后保留多少 genes
sum(keep)
## [1] 25582
# Filter the DESeq2 dataset
# 删除低表达 genes
dds <- dds[keep, ]


# Check the new dimensions
# 查看过滤之后剩余多少 genes 和 samples
dim(dds)
## [1] 25582    12
# Apply variance stabilizing transformation (VST)
# 将 count data 转换为更适合 PCA 和 clustering 的尺度
# VST主要用于 visualization，不是用来替代 raw counts 做DE分析
vsd <- vst(
  dds,
  blind = FALSE
)


# Inspect the transformed expression matrix
# 查看 VST 转换后的数据
head(assay(vsd)[, 1:4])
##           GSM4494689 GSM4494690 GSM4494691 GSM4494692
## 100287102   6.191852   5.698848   5.739326   5.800555
## 653635      9.158226   8.902272   8.919032   8.852316
## 102466751   6.260387   5.799471   6.140101   6.092928
## 100996442   8.285690   7.280566   6.884358   6.686196
## 729737      8.721412   8.967377   7.793408   7.243351
## 102725121   6.168082   5.698848   5.795359   5.614815
# Generate PCA data
# 使用 VST-transformed expression data 进行 PCA
pca_data <- plotPCA(
  
  # VST-transformed data
  # 使用经过 VST 转换的数据
  vsd,
  
  # Group samples according to condition
  # 告诉 PCA 图按照 Cancer / Normal 区分样本
  intgroup = "condition",
  
  # Return the PCA coordinates instead of directly plotting
  # 返回 PCA 数据，方便后面使用 ggplot2 自定义作图
  returnData = TRUE
)
## using ntop=500 top features by variance
# Calculate the percentage of variance explained by PC1 and PC2
# 计算 PC1 和 PC2 分别解释多少总体 variation
percent_var <- round(
  100 * attr(
    pca_data,
    "percentVar"
  )
)


# Check PCA data
# 查看 PCA 结果
head(pca_data)

# Load ggplot2
# 用于绘制 PCA 图
library(ggplot2)


# Plot PCA
# 每一个点代表一个 sample
# Cancer 和 Normal 使用不同颜色表示
pca_plot <- ggplot(
  pca_data,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    color = condition,
    label = name
  )
) +
  
  # Add sample points
  # 绘制每个sample
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  
  # Label x and y axes with explained variance
  # 在坐标轴上显示PC1和PC2解释的variation比例
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Breast Cancer and Adjacent Normal Tissues",
    x = paste0(
      "PC1: ",
      percent_var[1],
      "% variance"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PC2: ",
      percent_var[2],
      "% variance"
    ),
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  
  # Use a clean plotting theme
  # 使用简洁的图形主题
  theme_classic()


# Display PCA plot
# 显示PCA图
pca_plot

library(pheatmap)


# Calculate sample-to-sample correlation
# 计算任意两个samples之间的gene-expression correlation
sample_cor <- cor(
  assay(vsd)
)


# Prepare sample annotation for the heatmap
# 在heatmap上标注每个sample属于Cancer还是Normal
annotation_col <- metadata[, c(
  "condition",
  "patient"
)]


# Draw sample correlation heatmap
# correlation越高，说明两个sample整体表达模式越相似
pheatmap(
  sample_cor,
  
  # Add condition and patient information
  # 添加sample分组和patient信息
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  
  # Display sample names
  # 显示sample ID
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  
  # Heatmap title
  # 图标题
  main = "Sample Correlation Heatmap"
)

# Run the complete DESeq2 differential expression pipeline
# 1. normalization
# 2. dispersion estimation
# 3. negative binomial model fitting
# 4. statistical testing
dds <- DESeq(dds)
## estimating size factors
## estimating dispersions
## gene-wise dispersion estimates
## mean-dispersion relationship
## final dispersion estimates
## fitting model and testing
# Extract differential expression results
res <- results(
  dds,
  
  # Define the comparison:
  # Cancer / Normal
  contrast = c(
    "condition",
    "Cancer",
    "Normal"
  )
)


# Display a summary of differential expression results
# 查看上调、下调、显著gene的大致数量
summary(res)

# 并把 GeneID 从 row names 恢复成普通 column
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column("GeneID")

# Save the complete DESeq2 results
write.csv(
  res_df,
  "results/GSE133998_DESeq2_all_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
# Classify genes according to significance and direction
# 根据adjusted p-value和log2FoldChange把genes分成：
# Up、Down、Not significant
deg_df <- res_df %>%
  mutate(
    regulation = case_when(
      
      # Significantly upregulated in Cancer
      # Cancer中显著上调：
      # padj < 0.001 且 log2FC > 1
      !is.na(padj) &
        padj < 0.001 &
        log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Up",
      
      # Significantly downregulated in Cancer
      # Cancer中显著下调：
      # padj < 0.001 且 log2FC < -1
      !is.na(padj) &
        padj < 0.001 &
        log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Down",
      
      # All other genes are classified as not significant
      # 其余genes归为Not significant
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )


# Count the number of genes in each category
# 统计Up、Down和Not significant各有多少genes
table(deg_df$regulation)
## 
##            Down Not significant              Up 
##             443           24844             295

## [1] "methods"
# Read the gene annotation file
# 重新读取gene annotation文件
# 使用gene_annotation作为对象名，避免与R自带的annotation函数冲突
gene_annotation <- read.delim(
  "data/Human.GRCh38.p13.annot.tsv.gz",
  
  # The first row contains column names
  header = TRUE,
  
  # The file is tab-separated
  sep = "\t",
  
  # Do not specially parse quotation marks
  quote = "",
  
  # Fill incomplete rows with NA if necessary
  fill = TRUE,
  
  # Keep the original column names
  check.names = FALSE
)


# Check the class of the new object
class(gene_annotation)
## [1] "data.frame"
# Check dimensions
dim(gene_annotation)
## [1] 39376    18
# Check column names
colnames(gene_annotation)
##  [1] "GeneID"        "Symbol"        "Description"   "Synonyms"     
##  [5] "GeneType"      "EnsemblGeneID" "Status"        "ChrAcc"       
##  [9] "ChrStart"      "ChrStop"       "Orientation"   "Length"       
## [13] "GOFunctionID"  "GOProcessID"   "GOComponentID" "GOFunction"   
## [17] "GOProcess"     "GOComponent"
# Make sure GeneID has the same data type in both datasets
res_df$GeneID <- as.character(res_df$GeneID)

gene_annotation$GeneID <- as.character(
  gene_annotation$GeneID
)


# Select the annotation columns needed for downstream analysis
annotation_small <- gene_annotation %>%
  select(
    GeneID,
    Symbol,
    GeneType,
    Description
  )
# Add gene annotation to the differential expression results
# 根据GeneID，把Symbol、GeneType和Description加入DESeq2结果中
deg_annotated <- deg_df %>%
  left_join(
    annotation_small,
    by = "GeneID"
  )


# Check whether annotation was added successfully
# 查看注释后的结果
head(
  deg_annotated[, c(
    "GeneID",
    "Symbol",
    "GeneType",
    "log2FoldChange",
    "padj",
    "regulation"
  )]
)

# Check how many genes do not have a gene symbol

sum(
  is.na(deg_annotated$Symbol) |

)
## [1] 0
library(ggplot2)

# Create a volcano plot
# Volcano plot 用于同时展示：
# x-axis = log2FoldChange，表示表达变化方向和幅度
# y-axis = -log10(padj)，表示统计学显著性
volcano_plot <- ggplot(
  deg_annotated,
  aes(
    x = log2FoldChange,
    y = -log10(padj),
    color = regulation
  )
) +
  
  # Draw one point for each gene
  # 每一个点代表一个 gene
  # alpha 用于设置透明度，避免大量点完全重叠
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # Add vertical cutoff lines at log2FC = -1 and +1
  # 添加 log2FoldChange 阈值线
  # 左边 -1：显著下调的 effect-size cutoff
  # 右边 +1：显著上调的 effect-size cutoff
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-1, 1),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  # Add horizontal cutoff line for padj = 0.001
  # 因为 y-axis 是 -log10(padj)
  # 所以 padj = 0.001 对应 -log10(0.001) = 3
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.001),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  # Add title and axis labels
  labs(
    title = "Differential Gene Expression: Cancer vs Normal",
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value",
    color = "Regulation"
  ) +
  
  # Use a clean visual theme
  theme_classic()


# Display the volcano plot
volcano_plot

# Select significantly differentially expressed genes
# 只保留满足我们DEG阈值的genes
sig_genes <- deg_annotated %>%
  filter(
    regulation != "Not significant"
  )


# Sort significant genes by adjusted p-value
# 按padj从小到大排序
# padj越小，统计学证据越强
sig_genes <- sig_genes %>%
  arrange(padj)


# Select the top 30 most significant genes
# 选择padj最小的前30个DEGs用于heatmap
# 这样可以展示最有代表性的表达差异
top30 <- sig_genes %>%
  slice_head(n = 30)


# Display the selected top genes
# 查看最终进入heatmap的30个genes
top30 %>%
  select(
    GeneID,
    Symbol,
    log2FoldChange,
    padj,
    regulation
  )

# Extract the GeneIDs of the top 30 DEGs
# 提取top 30 genes对应的GeneID
top_gene_ids <- top30$GeneID


# Extract VST-transformed expression values for the top genes
# 从VST后的expression matrix中提取这30个genes
# rows = genes
# columns = samples
heatmap_mat <- assay(vsd)[
  top_gene_ids,
]


# Check the dimensions of the heatmap matrix
dim(heatmap_mat)
## [1] 30 12
# Standardize expression values for each gene using Z-score
# 对每个gene进行row-wise标准化
#
# 这样做的目的：
# heatmap主要展示同一个gene在不同samples之间的相对高低表达
# 而不是比较不同genes本身的绝对表达量
#
# t()第一次：
# 把genes和samples交换
#
# scale()：
# 对每个gene计算Z-score
#
# t()第二次：
# 再把matrix转回 genes × samples
heatmap_z <- t(
  scale(
    t(heatmap_mat)
  )
)
# Replace GeneID row names with gene symbols
# 将heatmap中的row names从数字GeneID改成更容易解释的gene symbol
rownames(heatmap_z) <- top30$Symbol
library(pheatmap)


# Prepare sample annotation
# 在heatmap顶部显示Cancer/Normal和patient信息
heatmap_annotation <- metadata[, c(
  "condition",
  "patient"
)]


# Draw the heatmap
# rows = top 30 DEGs
# columns = 12 samples
#
# 每个格子的值是该gene在该sample中的Z-score
# 正值表示相对于该gene自身平均水平表达较高
# 负值表示相对于该gene自身平均水平表达较低
pheatmap(
  heatmap_z,
  
  # Add sample condition and patient information
  # 在heatmap顶部添加sample信息
  annotation_col = heatmap_annotation,
  
  # Cluster genes
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  
  # Cluster samples
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  
  # Display gene symbols
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  
  # Display sample names
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  
  # Add figure title
  main = "Top 30 Differentially Expressed Genes"
)

# Draw a cleaner heatmap for presentation
# 为PPT绘制更清晰的heatmap
pheatmap(
  heatmap_z,
  
  # Add sample information
  # 添加Cancer/Normal和patient注释
  annotation_col = heatmap_annotation,
  
  # Cluster genes and samples
  # 对genes和samples进行层次聚类
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  
  # Show gene symbols and sample IDs
  # 显示gene symbol和sample ID
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  
  # Reduce gene-name font size
  # 缩小gene symbol字体，避免文字重叠
  fontsize_row = 7,
  
  # Reduce sample-name font size
  # 缩小sample ID字体
  fontsize_col = 8,
  
  # Add figure title
  # 添加图标题
  main = "Top 30 Differentially Expressed Genes"
)

# Select significantly upregulated genes in Cancer
# 提取在Cancer中显著上调的genes
# regulation == "Up"：
# padj < 0.001 且 log2FoldChange > 1
up_genes <- deg_annotated %>%
  filter(
    regulation == "Up",
    !is.na(Symbol),
    Symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  
  # Extract only gene symbols
  # Enrichr主要使用gene symbol作为输入
  pull(Symbol) %>%
  
  # Remove duplicated gene symbols
  # 如果多个GeneID对应同一个Symbol，只保留一个
  unique()


# Select significantly downregulated genes in Cancer
# 提取在Cancer中显著下调的genes
# regulation == "Down"：
# padj < 0.001 且 log2FoldChange < -1
down_genes <- deg_annotated %>%
  filter(
    regulation == "Down",
    !is.na(Symbol),
    Symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  
  # Extract gene symbols
  # 提取gene symbol
  pull(Symbol) %>%
  
  # Remove duplicated gene symbols
  # 删除重复symbol
  unique()

# Define the Enrichr databases used for pathway analysis
# 选择用于功能富集分析的gene-set databases
enrichr_dbs <- c(
  
  # Gene Ontology Biological Process
  # 主要描述genes参与哪些生物学过程
  "GO_Biological_Process_2023",
  
  # KEGG human pathways
  # 包含经典代谢和信号通路
  "KEGG_2021_Human",
  
  # Reactome biological pathways
  # 提供较详细的生物学反应和pathway信息
  "Reactome_2022",
  
  # MSigDB Hallmark gene sets
  # 50个高度概括、较容易解释的核心生物学主题
  "MSigDB_Hallmark_2020"
)
# Perform enrichment analysis for genes upregulated in Cancer
# 将Cancer中显著上调的gene list提交给Enrichr
enrichr_up <- enrichr(
  up_genes,
  enrichr_dbs
)

# Select significantly enriched Hallmark pathways
# 只保留adjusted p-value < 0.05的显著Hallmark pathways
hallmark_up_sig <- hallmark_up %>%
  filter(
    Adjusted.P.value < 0.05
  )


# Select the top 10 most significant pathways
# 按adjusted p-value从小到大排序，并选择前10条
hallmark_up_top10 <- hallmark_up_sig %>%
  arrange(
    Adjusted.P.value
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = 10
  )


# Create a variable for visualization
# 将adjusted p-value转换为-log10(padj)
# 数值越大，表示pathway enrichment越显著
hallmark_up_top10 <- hallmark_up_top10 %>%
  mutate(
    log10_padj = -log10(
      Adjusted.P.value
    )
  )
# Create a bar plot of the top enriched Hallmark pathways
# 绘制Cancer中上调genes的Top Hallmark enrichment结果
hallmark_plot <- ggplot(
  hallmark_up_top10,
  aes(
    x = reorder(
      Term,
      log10_padj
    ),
    y = log10_padj
  )
) +
  
  # Draw bars
  # 每一根bar代表一个enriched pathway
  geom_col() +
  
  # Flip coordinates
  # 将pathway名称放在纵轴，方便阅读较长的名称
  coord_flip() +
  
  # Add title and axis labels
  # y-axis = -log10(adjusted p-value)
  # 数值越大代表enrichment越显著
  labs(
    title = "Hallmark Pathways Enriched in Cancer-Upregulated Genes",
    x = "Hallmark Pathway",
    y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value"
  ) +
  
  # Use a clean plotting theme
  # 使用简洁的绘图主题
  theme_classic()


# Display the enrichment plot
# 显示最终的Hallmark enrichment bar plot
hallmark_plot

# Prepare a ranked gene table for FGSEA
# 为FGSEA准备所有genes的排名表
#
# FGSEA不使用DEG cutoff，而是使用所有可用genes
# 这里使用DESeq2的stat作为ranking metric
fgsea_rank_df <- deg_annotated %>%
  
  # Remove genes without a valid DESeq2 statistic
  # 删除stat为NA的genes
  filter(
    !is.na(stat),
    !is.na(Symbol),
    Symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep the columns needed for ranking
  # 保留gene symbol和DESeq2 stat
  select(
    Symbol,
    stat
  )


# Remove duplicated gene symbols
# 如果多个GeneID对应同一个Symbol，只保留一个
#
# 这里先按stat绝对值从大到小排序
# 保留统计信号最强的那一个
fgsea_rank_df <- fgsea_rank_df %>%
  arrange(
    desc(abs(stat))
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Symbol,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


# Check the ranked gene table
# 查看整理后的ranked gene数据
head(fgsea_rank_df)
##    Symbol     stat
## 1 CNTNAP2 8.770778
## 2    COMP 8.067307
## 3  LRRC15 7.962075
## 4   IGSF6 7.868408
## 5   BCAS1 7.431776
## 6   SAMD9 7.290785
# Check how many unique genes are available
# 查看最终有多少unique gene symbols可以用于FGSEA
nrow(fgsea_rank_df)
## [1] 25582
# Convert the ranked gene table into a named numeric vector
# 将data.frame转换成FGSEA需要的named numeric vector
ranks <- fgsea_rank_df$stat


# Use gene symbols as names of the ranking values
# 给每个stat值加上对应的gene symbol
names(ranks) <- fgsea_rank_df$Symbol


# Sort genes from highest stat to lowest stat
# 按stat从大到小排序
#
# ranking顶部：
# 更倾向于Cancer中高表达
#
# ranking底部：
# 更倾向于Cancer中低表达
ranks <- sort(
  ranks,
  decreasing = TRUE
)


# Inspect the top-ranked genes
# 查看Cancer-associated排名最高的genes
head(ranks)

# 查看Normal-associated排名较高，也就是Cancer中较低表达的genes

# Prepare a ranked gene list for FGSEA
# 为FGSEA准备所有genes的排序列表

# FGSEA不像Enrichr只使用显著DEGs
# 它使用所有genes，并根据一个统计量进行排序

# 这里使用DESeq2输出的stat作为ranking metric

ranked_df <- deg_annotated %>%
  
  # Remove genes without a valid DESeq2 statistic
  # 删除stat为NA的genes
  filter(
    !is.na(stat),
    !is.na(Symbol),
    Symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep gene symbol and DESeq2 statistic
  # 只保留FGSEA需要的gene symbol和stat
  select(
    Symbol,
    stat
  )
# Sort genes by the absolute value of DESeq2 stat
# 按stat绝对值从大到小排序
# 如果同一个Symbol对应多个GeneID，
# 后续会优先保留统计信号最强的那一个
ranked_df <- ranked_df %>%
  arrange(
    desc(abs(stat))
  )

# Remove duplicated gene symbols
# 删除重复的gene symbols
# 每个Symbol只保留一条记录
ranked_df <- ranked_df %>%
  distinct(
    Symbol,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# Check the first few rows
# 查看整理后的ranked gene table
head(ranked_df)
##    Symbol     stat
## 1 CNTNAP2 8.770778
## 2    COMP 8.067307
## 3  LRRC15 7.962075
## 4   IGSF6 7.868408
## 5   BCAS1 7.431776
## 6   SAMD9 7.290785
# Check how many unique genes remain
# 查看最终有多少unique gene symbols
nrow(ranked_df)
## [1] 25582
# Extract DESeq2 stat values
# 提取每个gene对应的DESeq2 stat
ranks <- ranked_df$stat


# Assign gene symbols as names
# 把gene symbol设置为每个stat值对应的名称
names(ranks) <- ranked_df$Symbol


# Sort genes from the highest stat to the lowest stat
# FGSEA要求ranked gene list有明确的排序
# stat越大，越偏向Cancer
# stat越小（负值越大），越偏向Normal
ranks <- sort(
  ranks,
  decreasing = TRUE
)


# Check genes at the top of the ranked list
# 查看排名最前面的genes
head(ranks)

# Load Hallmark, KEGG and Reactome pathways
# 加载Hallmark、KEGG和Reactome gene sets
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)

# Hallmark pathways
# 加载Hallmark pathways
hallmark <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  collection = "H"
)

# KEGG pathways
# 加载KEGG legacy pathways
kegg <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  collection = "C2",
  subcollection = "CP:KEGG_LEGACY"
)

# Reactome pathways
# 加载Reactome pathways
reactome <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  collection = "C2",
  subcollection = "CP:REACTOME"
)

# Combine all pathway-gene relationships
# 合并三个数据库中的pathway-gene对应关系
all_pathways_df <- bind_rows(
  hallmark %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  kegg %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  reactome %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
)

# Convert to the named list format required by fgsea
# 转换成fgsea需要的named list：
# 每一个pathway对应一组gene symbols
pathways <- split(
  all_pathways_df$gene_symbol,
  all_pathways_df$gs_name
)

# Check the number of pathways
# 查看总共有多少个pathways
length(pathways)
## [1] 2075
# View the first few pathway names
# 查看前几个pathway名称
head(names(pathways))
## [1] "HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS"        "HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION"
## [3] "HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE"   "HALLMARK_ANGIOGENESIS"       
## [5] "HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION"     "HALLMARK_APICAL_SURFACE"
library(fgsea)

# Run FGSEA using the ranked gene list
# 使用刚刚准备好的ranks进行FGSEA
fgsea_res <- fgsea(
  
  # Pathway gene sets
  # Hallmark + KEGG + Reactome
  pathways = pathways,
  
  # Ranked DESeq2 statistics
  # 所有genes按照stat排序后的named vector
  stats = ranks,
  
  # Minimum pathway size
  # pathway至少需要15个genes与ranked list匹配
  minSize = 15,
  
  # Maximum pathway size
  # 排除过大的gene sets
  maxSize = 500
)
## Warning in prepareStats(stats, scoreType, gseaParam): There are ties in the preranked stats (0.01% of the list).
## The order of those tied genes will be arbitrary, which may produce unexpected results.
# Convert results to a regular data frame
# 转换为普通data.frame方便查看
fgsea_df <- as.data.frame(fgsea_res)

# Sort by adjusted p-value
# 按padj从小到大排序
fgsea_df <- fgsea_df %>%
  arrange(padj)

# View the top 15 enriched pathways

# Select significantly upregulated genes in Cancer
# 提取Cancer中显著上调的genes
disease_up <- deg_annotated %>%
  
  # Keep significant upregulated genes with valid symbols
  # 只保留显著上调且有gene symbol的genes
  filter(
    regulation == "Up",
    !is.na(Symbol),
    Symbol != "",
    !is.na(stat)
  ) %>%
  
  # Sort by DESeq2 statistic
  # stat越大，Cancer-up的证据越强
  arrange(
    desc(stat)
  ) %>%
  
  # Remove duplicated gene symbols
  # 如果一个Symbol出现多次，只保留一个
  distinct(
    Symbol,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep the top 150 genes
  # 选择Cancer-up最强的150个genes
  slice_head(
    n = 150
  )

  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)
lincs_file <- "data/l1000cds2_assignment_data.rds"
# Load the LINCS assignment data
# 读取drug repurposing分析所需的LINCS reference data
assignment_data <- readRDS(
  lincs_file
)
# Extract the LINCS gene universe
# 提取LINCS reference中使用的gene universe
lincs_genes <- assignment_data$lincs_gene_universe


# Inspect the first few LINCS gene identifiers
# 查看LINCS gene universe到底是Entrez ID还是gene symbol
head(lincs_genes)
## [1] "10"    "100"   "1000"  "10000" "10001" "10003"
# Check the data type
# 查看gene identifier的数据类型
class(lincs_genes)
## [1] "character"
# Prepare Cancer-up disease signature using Entrez Gene IDs
# 使用Entrez Gene ID准备Cancer-up signature
disease_up_entrez <- deg_annotated %>%
  
  # Keep significantly upregulated genes with valid GeneID and stat
  # 保留Cancer中显著上调且GeneID/stat有效的genes
  filter(
    regulation == "Up",
    !is.na(GeneID),
    GeneID != "",
    !is.na(stat)
  ) %>%
  
  # Rank strongest Cancer-up genes first
  # stat越大，Cancer-up证据越强
  arrange(
    desc(stat)
  ) %>%
  
  # Remove duplicated GeneIDs
  # 删除重复GeneID
  distinct(
    GeneID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep top 150 genes
  # 保留前150个Cancer-up genes
  slice_head(
    n = 150
  ) %>%
  
  # Extract GeneID only
  # 只提取Entrez GeneID
  pull(
    GeneID
  )


# Prepare Cancer-down disease signature using Entrez Gene IDs
# 使用Entrez Gene ID准备Cancer-down signature
disease_down_entrez <- deg_annotated %>%
  
  # Keep significantly downregulated genes with valid GeneID and stat
  # 保留Cancer中显著下调且GeneID/stat有效的genes
  filter(
    regulation == "Down",
    !is.na(GeneID),
    GeneID != "",
    !is.na(stat)
  ) %>%
  
  # Rank strongest Cancer-down genes first
  # stat越负，Cancer-down证据越强
  arrange(
    stat
  ) %>%
  
  # Remove duplicated GeneIDs
  # 删除重复GeneID
  distinct(
    GeneID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep top 150 genes
  # 保留前150个Cancer-down genes
  slice_head(
    n = 150
  ) %>%
  
  # Extract GeneID only
  # 只提取Entrez GeneID
  pull(
    GeneID
  )


# Convert both disease signatures to character
# 转成character，确保和lincs_genes类型一致
disease_up_entrez <- as.character(
  disease_up_entrez
)

disease_down_entrez <- as.character(
  disease_down_entrez
)


# Check signature sizes
# 应该都是150
length(disease_up_entrez)
## [1] 150
length(disease_down_entrez)
## [1] 150
# Check the data type
# 应该都是character
class(disease_up_entrez)
## [1] "character"
class(disease_down_entrez)
## [1] "character"
# Inspect a few Entrez IDs
# 查看前几个Entrez Gene IDs
head(disease_up_entrez)
## [1] "26047"  "1311"   "131578" "10261"  "8537"   "54809"
head(disease_down_entrez)
## [1] "100132529" "100507500" "6898"      "92304"     "100287290" "64344"
# Combine Cancer-up and Cancer-down query genes
# 合并300个disease signature genes
all_query_genes <- c(
  disease_up_entrez,
  disease_down_entrez
)


# Find query genes represented in the LINCS gene universe
# 找出实际存在于LINCS数据库中的query genes
genes_in_lincs <- intersect(
  all_query_genes,
  lincs_genes
)


# Count the effective input
# 计算实际可以参与drug overlap分析的gene数量
effective_input <- length(
  genes_in_lincs
)


# Display the effective input
# 查看300个query genes中有多少被LINCS覆盖
paste(
  "Effective input:",
  effective_input,
  "out of",
  length(all_query_genes),
  "query genes"
)
## [1] "Effective input: 152 out of 300 query genes"
# Extract the drug reference signatures
# 提取课堂数据中的drug reference signatures
ref <- assignment_data$ref_signatures


# Check the structure of the reference table
# 查看drug reference中有哪些columns
colnames(ref)
## [1] "sig_id"   "compound" "cell"     "up_genes" "dn_genes"
# Check the first few rows
# 查看前几个drug signatures
head(ref)
##                          sig_id    compound   cell     up_genes     dn_genes
## 1  BRD-K86307448__P1A82__trt_cp allopurinol  P1A82 8321, 51.... 9, 1024,....
## 2   BRD-K86307448__MCF7__trt_cp allopurinol   MCF7 28969, 4.... 9141, 74....
## 3   BRD-A64297288__A375__trt_cp  amlodipine   A375 3880, 10.... 26354, 6....
## 4   BRD-A64297288__HT29__trt_cp  amlodipine   HT29 11325, 5.... 1969, 78....
## 5   BRD-K11433652__MCF7__trt_cp     aspirin   MCF7 9710, 88.... 51005, 8....
## 6 BRD-K11433652__MCF10A__trt_cp     aspirin MCF10A 1111, 82.... 79891, 4....
# Calculate reverse-mode gene overlaps for every drug signature
# 对每一个drug signature计算与disease signature的反向overlap
results <- ref %>%
  
  # Process one drug signature at a time
  # 每一行单独计算，避免对整个list-column一起操作
  rowwise() %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    # Disease-up genes overlapping with drug-down genes
    # Cancer中上调，但drug处理后下调
    # 这是我们希望看到的reversal方向之一
    overlap_up_dn = length(
      intersect(
        disease_up_entrez,
        as.character(dn_genes)
      )
    ),
    
    # Disease-down genes overlapping with drug-up genes
    # Cancer中下调，但drug处理后上调
    # 这是第二种希望看到的reversal方向
    overlap_dn_up = length(
      intersect(
        disease_down_entrez,
        as.character(up_genes)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Remove rowwise grouping
  # 恢复普通data.frame操作
  ungroup()
# Calculate total reverse overlap and normalized overlap score
# 计算每个drug signature的总反向overlap和score
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Total number of genes reversed by the drug
    # 两种反向overlap相加
    total_overlap = overlap_up_dn + overlap_dn_up,
    
    # Normalize by the effective LINCS input
    # 用152个effective genes作为分母
    score = total_overlap / effective_input
  ) %>%
  
  # Rank from highest reversal score to lowest
  # score越高，代表与disease signature的反向overlap越多
  arrange(
    desc(score)
  ) %>%
  
  # Add rank
  # 添加排名
  mutate(
    rank = row_number()
  )
# Display the top 20 drug signatures
# 查看反向overlap score最高的20个drug signatures
results %>%
  select(
    rank,
    compound,
    cell,
    overlap_up_dn,
    overlap_dn_up,
    total_overlap,
    score
  ) %>%
  head(20)

# Load packages needed for plotting
# 加载drug repurposing结果整理和绘图需要的packages
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)


# Select the top 20 drug signatures
# 选择overlap score最高的20个drug signatures
top20_plot <- results %>%
  
  # results已经按照score从高到低排列
  # 因此直接选择前20行
  head(20) %>%
  
  # Reorder compound names according to score
  # 根据score重新排列compound顺序
  mutate(
    compound = fct_reorder(
      str_to_sentence(compound),
      score
    )
  )


# Create the Top 20 drug overlap-score plot
# 绘制Top 20候选药物的gene overlap score
drug_plot <- ggplot(
  top20_plot,
  aes(
    x = score,
    y = compound,
    fill = score
  )
) +
  
  # Draw horizontal bars
  # 每根bar代表一个drug signature
  geom_col() +
  
  # Add axis labels and title
  # 添加坐标轴和标题
  labs(
    x = "Overlap Score",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Top 20 Drugs by Gene Overlap Score"
  ) +
  
  # Use a clean theme
  # 使用课堂代码中的简洁主题
  theme_minimal()


# Display the plot
# 显示drug repurposing结果图
drug_plot

# Create a label containing both compound and cell line
# 将compound和cell line组合起来，避免不同cell中的drug signature混淆
top20_plot_cell <- results %>%
  
  # Select the top 20 signatures
  # 选择score最高的20条drug signatures
  head(20) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    # Combine drug name and cell line
    # 例如 Metformin (HA1E)
    drug_label = paste0(
      str_to_sentence(compound),
      " (",
      cell,
      ")"
    ),
    
    # Reorder labels according to overlap score
    # 按score重新排列
    drug_label = fct_reorder(
      drug_label,
      score
    )
  )


# Draw the drug-signature plot
# 同时显示compound和cell line
drug_cell_plot <- ggplot(
  top20_plot_cell,
  aes(
    x = score,
    y = drug_label,
    fill = score
  )
) +
  
  # Draw bars
  # 每根bar代表一个compound-cell signature
  geom_col() +
  
  # Add labels
  # 添加标题和坐标轴
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Drug Signatures by Disease-Signature Reversal Score",
    x = "Gene Overlap Score",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  
  # Use a clean theme
  # 使用简洁主题
  theme_minimal()
